                    <ul class="method-props">
                        <li>Advantage computed from final reward, applied uniformly to all tokens in trajectory</li>
                        <li>No per-step credit distinction — all tokens weighted equally</li>

                <div class="method-card vapo-method">
                    <div class="method-card-sub">Value-Model-Based (VAPO)</div>
                    <div class="method-card-title">Token-Level Credit Assignment</div>
                    <ul class="method-props">
                        <li><strong>Precise attribution:</strong> traces each token's impact on returns via bootstrapped value estimates</li>
                        <li><strong>Lower variance:</strong> per-token value estimates vs. Monte Carlo trajectory average</li>
                        <li><strong>Generalization:</strong> trained value model shares information across samples</li>
                        <li><strong>Critical for multi-step:</strong> step-level errors in long CoT cause catastrophic failures — granular credit is essential</li>
                        <li>Enables VAPO to learn which reasoning steps are genuinely useful</li>
                    </ul>

    <!-- ========================================================
         PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         ======================================================== -->
    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.scrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupScrollNav();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer: add .visible for animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.current = idx;
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* Keyboard navigation */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            this.goTo(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* Touch/swipe navigation */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* Scroll wheel navigation */
            setupScrollNav() {
                let lastTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastTime < 600) return;
                    lastTime = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* Progress bar update */
            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* Navigation dots */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }
        }

        /* Initialize on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>VAPO: Value-Model-Based RL for Advanced Reasoning</title>

    <!-- Electric Studio-inspired: Manrope for precision and authority -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES — VAPO THEME
           Electric Studio inspired: dark base, sharp blue/white contrast,
           data-forward with amber accent for results emphasis
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            --bg-deep:      #07090e;
            --bg-panel:     #0d1017;
            --bg-card:      #131924;
            --bg-card-alt:  #0f1520;
            --border:       rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            --border-accent:rgba(55,135,255,0.4);

            --text-primary:   #f0f4ff;
            --text-secondary: #8896b0;
            --text-muted:     #4a5568;

            --accent-blue:    #3787ff;
            --accent-blue-2:  #1f5fd4;
            --accent-amber:   #f5a623;
            --accent-green:   #3ecf8e;
            --accent-red:     #ef4444;
            --accent-cyan:    #22d3ee;

            /* VAPO brand color — distinctive gold-amber */
            --vapo-gold:      #f5a623;
            --dapo-blue:      #3787ff;
            --baseline-gray:  #4a5568;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:    'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Clamp scales — from viewport-base.css overrides */
            --title-size:    clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 4.2rem);
            --h2-size:       clamp(1.2rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size:       clamp(0.95rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size:     clamp(0.75rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            --small-size:    clamp(0.65rem, 0.9vw, 0.8rem);
            --mono-size:     clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.875rem);
            --label-size:    clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);

            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.8rem);
            --element-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);

            --ease-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --ease-back: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT BASE — MANDATORY (from viewport-base.css)
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            background: var(--bg-deep);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            background: var(--bg-deep);
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.3rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.1rem, 3.5vw, 2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(0.95rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.85rem, 2.2vw, 1.2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        h2 {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }
        .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--mono-size); }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED SLIDE COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Slide header with accent bar */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .slide-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: 0.35em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Top accent line */
        .accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue) 0%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
        }

        /* Background grid pattern */
        .grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.018) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.018) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Corner glow decorations */
        .glow-corner {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.15;
        }
        .glow-tl {
            width: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            height: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            top: calc(-1 * clamp(100px, 15vw, 200px));
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(100px, 15vw, 200px));
            background: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .glow-br {
            width: clamp(150px, 25vw, 350px);
            height: clamp(150px, 25vw, 350px);
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 180px));
            right: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 180px));
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* Tags / badges */
        .tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            background: rgba(55,135,255,0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            border: 1px solid rgba(55,135,255,0.3);
        }
        .tag.amber {
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.15);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3);
        }
        .tag.green {
            background: rgba(62,207,142,0.12);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            border-color: rgba(62,207,142,0.3);
        }
        .tag.red {
            background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
        }

        /* Stat callout box */
        .stat-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }
        .stat-number {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           Triggered by .visible class via Intersection Observer
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: opacity 0.55s var(--ease-expo),
                        transform 0.55s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.19s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.26s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.33s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.47s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(8)  { transition-delay: 0.54s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.93);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .slide-title .title-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .slide-title .left-col {}
        .slide-title .right-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
        }
        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .title-main .vapo-highlight {
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.6vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 52ch;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .title-score-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.12) 0%, rgba(245,166,35,0.05) 100%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.35);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem) clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: clamp(180px, 22vw, 280px);
        }
        .score-number {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .score-bench {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-top: 0.3em;
        }
        .title-meta-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .title-divider {
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
        }
        .title-attribution {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .slide-title .title-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .slide-title .right-col { align-items: flex-start; }
            .title-meta-row { justify-content: flex-start; }
            .title-attribution { text-align: left; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .motivation-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .method-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.4);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.06), var(--bg-card));
        }
        .method-card-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method .method-card-title { color: var(--vapo-gold); }
        .method-card-sub {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .method-props {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .method-props li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5em;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .method-props li::before {
            content: '—';
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method .method-props li::before { color: var(--vapo-gold); }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .motivation-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE CHALLENGES
           =========================================== */
        .challenges-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .challenge-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .challenge-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(1)::before { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(2)::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(3)::before { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .challenge-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1;
            opacity: 0.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(1) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-red); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(2) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-amber); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(3) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-cyan); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .challenge-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .challenges-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: VAPO FRAMEWORK
           =========================================== */
        .framework-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
            max-height: min(70vh, 550px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .challenge-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .challenge-pill {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }
        .challenge-pill .dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .cp-bias .dot   { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .cp-length .dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .cp-sparse .dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .cp-bias   { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.25); }
        .cp-length { color: var(--accent-amber); border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.25); }
        .cp-sparse { color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: rgba(34,211,238,0.25); }
        .col-header {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .solutions-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .solution-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .solution-name {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .solution-desc {
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.74rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .solution-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.25em;
            width: fit-content;
            padding: 0.12em 0.45em;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.62rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: auto;
        }
        .st-bias   { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); }

                        <li>Subtle step-level errors are indistinguishable from correct steps</li>

                        <li><strong>Lower variance:</strong> per-token value estimates vs. Monte Carlo trajectory average</li>
                        <li><strong>Generalization:</strong> trained value model shares information across samples</li>
                        <li><strong>Critical for multi-step:</strong> step-level errors in long CoT cause catastrophic failures — granular credit is essential</li>

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.scrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupScrollNav();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer: add .visible for animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.current = idx;
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* Keyboard navigation */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            this.goTo(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* Touch/swipe navigation */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* Scroll wheel navigation */
            setupScrollNav() {
                let lastTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastTime < 600) return;
                    lastTime = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* Progress bar update */
            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* Navigation dots */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }
        }

        /* Initialize on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

           VIEWPORT BASE — MANDATORY (from viewport-base.css)
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            background: var(--bg-deep);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            background: var(--bg-deep);
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.3rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.1rem, 3.5vw, 2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(0.95rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.85rem, 2.2vw, 1.2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        h2 {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.2;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.55;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }
        .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--mono-size); }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED SLIDE COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Slide header with accent bar */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .slide-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: 0.35em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Top accent line */
        .accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue) 0%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
        }

        /* Background grid pattern */
        .grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.018) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.018) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Corner glow decorations */
        .glow-corner {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.15;
        }
        .glow-tl {
            width: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            height: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            top: calc(-1 * clamp(100px, 15vw, 200px));
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(100px, 15vw, 200px));
            background: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .glow-br {
            width: clamp(150px, 25vw, 350px);
            height: clamp(150px, 25vw, 350px);
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 180px));
            right: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 180px));
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* Tags / badges */
        .tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            background: rgba(55,135,255,0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            border: 1px solid rgba(55,135,255,0.3);
        }
        .tag.amber {
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.15);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3);
        }
        .tag.green {
            background: rgba(62,207,142,0.12);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            border-color: rgba(62,207,142,0.3);
        }
        .tag.red {
            background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
        }

        /* Stat callout box */
        .stat-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }
        .stat-number {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           Triggered by .visible class via Intersection Observer
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: opacity 0.55s var(--ease-expo),
                        transform 0.55s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1)  { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2)  { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3)  { transition-delay: 0.19s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4)  { transition-delay: 0.26s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5)  { transition-delay: 0.33s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6)  { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7)  { transition-delay: 0.47s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(8)  { transition-delay: 0.54s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.93);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .slide-title .title-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .slide-title .left-col {}
        .slide-title .right-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
        }
        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .title-main .vapo-highlight {
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.6vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 52ch;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .title-score-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.12) 0%, rgba(245,166,35,0.05) 100%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.35);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem) clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: clamp(180px, 22vw, 280px);
        }
        .score-number {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .score-bench {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-top: 0.3em;
        }
        .title-meta-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .title-divider {
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem) 0;
        }
        .title-attribution {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .slide-title .title-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .slide-title .right-col { align-items: flex-start; }
            .title-meta-row { justify-content: flex-start; }
            .title-attribution { text-align: left; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .motivation-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .method-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.4);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.06), var(--bg-card));
        }
        .method-card-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method .method-card-title { color: var(--vapo-gold); }
        .method-card-sub {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .method-props {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .method-props li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5em;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .method-props li::before {
            content: '—';
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .method-card.vapo-method .method-props li::before { color: var(--vapo-gold); }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .motivation-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE CHALLENGES
           =========================================== */
        .challenges-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }
        .challenge-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .challenge-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(1)::before { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(2)::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(3)::before { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .challenge-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1;
            opacity: 0.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(1) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-red); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(2) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-amber); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-card:nth-child(3) .challenge-num { color: var(--accent-cyan); opacity: 0.3; }
        .challenge-title {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .challenge-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .challenges-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: VAPO FRAMEWORK
           =========================================== */
        .framework-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
            max-height: min(70vh, 550px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .challenge-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .challenge-pill {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }
        .challenge-pill .dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .cp-bias .dot   { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .cp-length .dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .cp-sparse .dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .cp-bias   { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.25); }
        .cp-length { color: var(--accent-amber); border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.25); }
        .cp-sparse { color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: rgba(34,211,238,0.25); }
        .col-header {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .solutions-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .solution-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .solution-name {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .solution-desc {
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.74rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .solution-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.25em;
            width: fit-content;
            padding: 0.12em 0.45em;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.62rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: auto;
        }
        .st-bias   { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); }
        .st-length { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.12); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .st-sparse { background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .st-multi  { background: rgba(55,135,255,0.1); color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .solution-card.novel {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.35);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.05), var(--bg-card));
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .framework-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .solutions-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: LENGTH-ADAPTIVE GAE
           =========================================== */
        .gae-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gae-concept {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .gae-bullets {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .gae-bullets li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.6em;
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding-left: 0;
        }
        .gae-bullets li .bullet-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: 1.5em; height: 1.5em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            margin-top: 0.1em;
        }
        .gae-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .lambda-row {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .lambda-row.short { border-color: rgba(55,135,255,0.3); }
        .lambda-row.long  { border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3); }
        .lambda-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .lambda-content { flex: 1; }
        .lambda-title {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .lambda-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }
        .lambda-badge {
            padding: 0.3em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .lambda-row.short .lambda-badge {
            background: rgba(55,135,255,0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .lambda-row.long .lambda-badge {
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.15);
            color: var(--vapo-gold);
        }
        .gae-insight {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,166,35,0.08), rgba(245,166,35,0.03));
            border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.25);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .gae-insight strong { color: var(--vapo-gold); }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {

    <!-- ========================================================
         SLIDE 2: MOTIVATION
         ======================================================== -->
    <section class="slide" id="slide-2" aria-label="Motivation slide">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="grid-bg"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <span class="slide-num">02 / 09</span>
                <div>
                    <h2 class="reveal">Why Value Models? Finer Credit Assignment<br>for Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning</h2>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="motivation-grid reveal">
                <!-- Value-Model-Free card -->
                <div class="method-card">
                    <div class="method-card-sub">Value-Model-Free (GRPO / DAPO)</div>
                    <div class="method-card-title">Trajectory-Level Advantage</div>
                    <ul class="method-props">
                        <li>Advantage computed from final reward, applied uniformly to all tokens in trajectory</li>
                        <li>No per-step credit distinction — all tokens weighted equally</li>
                        <li>High variance: single Monte Carlo estimate per trajectory</li>
                        <li>Subtle step-level errors are indistinguishable from correct steps</li>
                        <li>Dominated LLM RL training prior to VAPO</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <!-- Value-Model-Based card -->
                <div class="method-card vapo-method">
                    <div class="method-card-sub">Value-Model-Based (VAPO)</div>
                    <div class="method-card-title">Token-Level Credit Assignment</div>
                    <ul class="method-props">
                        <li><strong>Precise attribution:</strong> traces each token's impact on returns via bootstrapped value estimates</li>
                        <li><strong>Lower variance:</strong> per-token value estimates vs. Monte Carlo trajectory average</li>
                        <li><strong>Generalization:</strong> trained value model shares information across samples</li>
                        <li><strong>Critical for multi-step:</strong> step-level errors in long CoT cause catastrophic failures — granular credit is essential</li>
                        <li>Enables VAPO to learn which reasoning steps are genuinely useful</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ========================================================
         SLIDE 3: THREE CORE CHALLENGES
         ======================================================== -->
    <section class="slide" id="slide-3" aria-label="Three challenges slide">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="grid-bg"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <span class="slide-num">03 / 09</span>
                <div>
                    <h2 class="reveal">Three Challenges Plaguing Value-Model-Based RL<br>in Long Chain-of-Thought Tasks</h2>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="challenges-grid">
                <div class="challenge-card reveal">
                    <div class="challenge-num">01</div>
                    <div class="challenge-title">Value Model Bias</div>
                    <p class="challenge-desc">
                        Long trajectories with bootstrapped learning introduce systematic
                        bias into value estimates. Errors compound across many reasoning
                        steps, making value estimates unreliable at the start of training.
                    </p>
                    <span class="tag red" style="width:fit-content; margin-top:auto;">High Priority</span>
                </div>

                <div class="challenge-card reveal">
                    <div class="challenge-num">02</div>
                    <div class="challenge-title">Heterogeneous Sequence Lengths</div>
                    <p class="challenge-desc">
                        Reasoning traces span highly variable lengths — from short
                        confirmations to multi-page derivations. A single fixed
                        bias-variance tradeoff (λ) cannot be optimal for all response lengths.
                    </p>
                    <span class="tag amber" style="width:fit-content; margin-top:auto;">Novel Challenge</span>
                </div>

                <div class="challenge-card reveal">
                    <div class="challenge-num">03</div>
                    <div class="challenge-title">Reward Signal Sparsity</div>
                    <p class="challenge-desc">
                        Only the final <eos> token receives a reward signal.
                        In long CoT, this sparsity is extreme — thousands of tokens
                        derive signal from a single endpoint, weakening the learning gradient.
                    </p>
                    <span class="tag" style="width:fit-content; margin-top:auto;">Exacerbated by CoT</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- ========================================================
         SLIDE 4: VAPO FRAMEWORK OVERVIEW
         ======================================================== -->
    <section class="slide" id="slide-4" aria-label="VAPO framework overview">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="grid-bg"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <span class="slide-num">04 / 09</span>
                <div>
                    <h2 class="reveal">VAPO Framework: Integrated Solutions<br>for Value-Model-Based Reasoning RL</h2>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="framework-layout reveal">
                <!-- Left: challenges -->
                <div class="challenge-col">
                    <div class="col-header">Challenges Addressed</div>
                    <div class="challenge-pill cp-bias"><span class="dot"></span> Value Model Bias</div>
                    <div style="height: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.5rem);"></div>
                    <div class="challenge-pill cp-length"><span class="dot"></span> Heterogeneous Lengths</div>
                    <div style="height: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.5rem);"></div>
                    <div class="challenge-pill cp-sparse"><span class="dot"></span> Reward Sparsity</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Right: solutions grid -->
                <div>
                    <div class="col-header" style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">VAPO Components</div>
                    <div class="solutions-grid">
                        <div class="solution-card">
                            <div class="solution-name">Value-Pretraining</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Pre-trains the value model before RL to reduce initial bias from bootstrapped estimates on long trajectories.</div>
                            <span class="solution-tag st-bias">Bias</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="solution-card">
                            <div class="solution-name">Decoupled-GAE</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Separates GAE computation from policy for more robust value estimation. Adapted from VC-PPO.</div>
                            <span class="solution-tag st-bias">Bias</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="solution-card novel">
                            <div class="solution-name">Length-Adaptive GAE ★</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Dynamically adjusts λ per response length. Short → low λ (low variance). Long → high λ (low bias).</div>
                            <span class="solution-tag st-length">Novel · Length</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="solution-card">
                            <div class="solution-name">Token-level Loss</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Normalizes loss at token level instead of sequence level, preventing length bias in gradient updates.</div>
                            <span class="solution-tag st-sparse">Sparsity</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="solution-card">
                            <div class="solution-name">Positive Example LM Loss</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Self-imitation learning on correct trajectories to reinforce high-quality reasoning chains.</div>
                            <span class="solution-tag st-sparse">Sparsity</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="solution-card">
                            <div class="solution-name">Clip-Higher + Group-Sampling</div>
                            <div class="solution-desc">Asymmetric clipping (DAPO) for exploration; multi-response sampling (GRPO) for baseline estimation.</div>

                        </div>

    <!-- ========================================================

         ======================================================== -->
    <section class="slide" id="slide-5" aria-label="Length-Adaptive GAE deep dive">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="grid-bg"></div>

        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <span class="slide-num">05 / 09</span>
                <div>
                    <h2 class="reveal">Length-Adaptive GAE: Dynamic λ Adjustment<br>for Variable Response Lengths</h2>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="gae-layout reveal">
                <div class="gae-concept">
                    <p style="font-size:var(--body-size); color:var(--text-secondary); line-height:1.6;">
                        In standard GAE, the λ parameter controls the bias-variance tradeoff uniformly.
                        But long-CoT reasoning produces <strong>wildly heterogeneous</strong> response lengths —
                        a single fixed λ is suboptimal for both short and long sequences simultaneously.
                    </p>

                    <ul class="gae-bullets">
                        <li>
                            <span class="bullet-icon" style="background:rgba(55,135,255,0.15); color:var(--accent-blue);">λ↓</span>
                            <span><strong>Short responses</strong> → lower λ prioritizes lower variance. Fewer bootstrapping steps mean bias is already low; reducing λ controls noise.</span>
                        </li>

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.scrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupScrollNav();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer: add .visible for animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.current = idx;
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* Keyboard navigation */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            this.goTo(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* Touch/swipe navigation */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* Scroll wheel navigation */
            setupScrollNav() {
                let lastTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastTime < 600) return;
                    lastTime = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* Progress bar update */
            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* Navigation dots */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }
        }

        /* Initialize on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
